correctness.rationale: For the precise three-equation Wang–Shao–Chai delay system, all parameters r,k,b,a,alpha,m,beta,d,theta,v,p,q,eta,e are strictly positive, both delays nonnegative, and the assumed solution is strictly positive and T-periodic. Integrating x3 prime over a complete period makes the delayed birth integral equal its undelayed counterpart. Normalizing by integral x3 defines dnu=x3 dt/integral x3; hence e/eta=int x2/(v+p*x2+q*x3) dnu. Since q*x3>0, this is strictly below int f(x2)dnu with f(u)=u/(v+pu), strictly concave because f double prime = -2pv/(v+pu)^3<0. Jensen yields e/eta<f(M3)=M3/(v+p*M3)<1/p. Thus eta>pe, and M3>ve/(eta-pe), where M3=int x2*x3/int x3. When tau2=0, division by current x3 and period integration of d log(x3)/dt instead supplies the ordinary-time version. That step is correctly NOT used for tau2>0. The result is conditional on strictly positive periodic solutions and does not assert existence, attraction, Hopf continuation, or an unweighted bound at positive tau2. Strict q and positive x3 matter.
residual_risks: The result does not establish existence or stability of periodic solutions.
For positive top-predator delay, period integration produces a top-predator-weighted mean, not an ordinary time mean.
Finite Fraction algebra checks corroborate only the rational rearrangement, not the universal periodic integration proof.

value.rationale: The Wang–Shao–Chai source studies Hopf-driven nonstationary predator coexistence and identifies the top-predator invasion level only at equilibria. An explicit necessary bound on the natural x3-weighted abundance of its intermediate predator along EVERY positive finite-amplitude periodic state, valid for arbitrary gestation delays, is a motivated nonlocal invariant of the published model, not a random parameter slice. The same exact threshold as local invasion makes it interpretable and usable as an analytic consistency check for proposed oscillatory branches. The tau2=0 ordinary mean statement clarifies a structurally important boundary in delay placement. It is a precise but modest self-contained mathematical fact: the proof is elementary once the right observable is chosen, it does not yield existence/stability or general permanence, and those limits do not erase its specific usefulness.
residual_risks: The inequality is necessary rather than sufficient and is conditional on positive periodic solutions.
For tau2>0 it constrains a weighted mean that depends on the predator density rather than the ordinary observed time mean.
The Jensen method itself is classical; significance is restricted to the motivated exact threshold in this model.

limitations: 2014 high-relevance paper full text not available through Oxford (vpn_disconnected); priority assessment remains best of knowledge with this explicit risk.
